_comment: Wave schedule. Count of a strain in wave w (w >= from_wave): round(base * (1 + growth_per_wave * (w - 1)) * size_multiplier). Strains with `every` only come every N waves. Stalkers hunt in their own packs of pack_min-pack_max (sheet v4: 20-50); everything else mixes into packs of pack_size_min-max. Waves arrive as packs spread over spawn_seconds from random canyon mouths. hp_growth_per_wave toughens every alien a little each wave.
